description: Commercial Parking Lots is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. Names of parking lot owners and inventory Update Frequency: Semi-Annually. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Consumer/Housing. Its tags are spaces, cars, commercial, parking, parkinglots. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: Montgomery County, MD. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
